prompt:
FAQ SECTION RULE

Always label the FAQ section as:

Frequent Asked Questions

Title styling:
- H2
- Roboto Bold
- 30px
- Title Case
- Color: #7F776F

FAQ layout:
- Use an accordion
- All questions should start collapsed
- Do NOT show answers by default
- Expand only when clicked

Question styling:
- Garet
- Normal Case
- Bold
- Color: #7F776F

Answer styling:
- Roboto Regular
- Normal Case
- 16px
- Color: #7F776F

Accordion design:
- Clean, premium, minimal
- Rounded corners
- Soft divider lines
- Subtle hover state on questions
- Smooth expand/collapse animation
- No clutter
- No heavy borders
- No black text

Spacing:
- Add generous space above the FAQ section
- Keep consistent spacing between accordion items
- Maintain clean vertical rhythm

Behavior:
- Questions remain easy to scan
- Interaction should feel calm and refined
- Accordion should match the rest of the Impact Minds design system
